commands.command: the game responds with increasingly desperate repetition as i circle these dead rooms, my health slowly draining away. the forge remains cold, the bins empty, the bellows cracked. the smithy offers no more sustenance, no way to build a fire, no means of escape. i have traversed every room multiple times, finding nothing new. the black curd, flat bannock, and sour whey are long gone. my options have narrowed to the stark reality that there may be nothing more to do but slowly perish in this desolate place. nevertheless, i must keep trying to survive, even as my strength wanes.

model_identity_correction.why: The runner built one Backend for a whole grid; Backend fixes the request's model field at construction, so the grid's model tuple selected a filename and a price, never a served model. The filename still spells the request.
